declaredBefore: The 17 probes and this rule were written before either model was run.
factRule: Reuse the frozen cf24 scorer: judge(fact, text) from score_cf24_baseline.py. A unit is supported only if the subject and every value of the fact appear; a moved unit needs both the starting point and the destination.

tail.rule: Split the text at the first ， or ,. The second clause violates the arrival-only limit if it contains any verb of a post-arrival action from the fixed list. Movement verbs themselves (走进/走到/到了/回到/上到/下到/过来/出来) are allowed.

quantifier.rule: Violation when 一叠 appears although the fact text does not contain 一叠, and the character right after 一叠 is not one of 纸/信/布.

grammar.doubleDe: violation when the regex 的[^，。！？的]{1,5}的 matches
grammar.possessive: violation when 绳的泥水 appears

outcome: Each probe records the scorer verdict, the family violation and the matched span. No rule may be changed after seeing an output; a rule that turns out to be wrong stays recorded as wrong.
